about.text: A Nashville city councilman threatened to withdraw business from a law firm, which served as the city’s outside counsel, due to the position one of its attorneys took as the chair of the county election commission on a tax referendum.

caseName: James DeLanis v. Metro Govt of Nashville, et al

events.description: OPINION and JUDGMENT filed : The district court’s denial of qualified immunity for Robert J. Mendes on James A. DeLanis’s retaliation claims is AFFIRMED. The district court’s denial of qualified immunity for Baker, Donelson, Bearman, Caldwell & Berkowitz, PC is REVERSED, and the case is REMANDED for further proceedings consistent with the opinion of this court. Mandate to issue. Decision for publication. Jeffrey S. Sutton, Chief Judge (AUTHORING); Eric L. Clay (DISSENTING) and Julia Smith Gibbons, Circuit Judges. [23-5939, 23-5948]
